intent: Structural growth guard only; the Task 8.2D-3a.3a.1 rebaseline adds one immutable SQLite provisioning journal plus recovery logic for crash-safe configured-root deployment-slot creation. A permanent private .bootstrap-lock SQLite mutex serializes inspection, bootstrap recovery, staging close, atomic no-replace publication, cleanup, and parent-directory fsync; its own empty-file, dirty-transaction, and committed-schema prefixes recover after real SIGKILL. The published journal binds one exact Runtime database pin and slot intent, uses an expected-digest BEGIN IMMEDIATE lock with a random liveness savepoint, and publishes hash-chained phase receipts through private staged files. Resume and abort validate current lineage, namespace disjointness, sidecars, pinned inode identity, and linked-but-not-parent-synced prefixes before physical mutation; five authority mutations are guarded by lock-liveness checks. Node support is fail-closed to versions with DatabaseSync URL-path support: >=22.15.0 <23 or >=23.10.0. This remains conditional process-live recovery on a verified local filesystem and does not claim protection against rollback of a complete current lineage, non-cooperating same-process lock destruction, dirty unpublished scratch-byte immutability, remote-filesystem locking, managed-writer quiesce, private signing, multi-host consensus, or public HTTP authority. It adds no route, environment field, largest-file growth, or import cycle.
